row.evidence: Flinto sells a $99 yearly Mac licence key per copy and Flinto Lite at '$20/Month per member', with team members added and removed manually on the team page; no SSO, SCIM or API is mentioned on its site.
row.notes: New row. None by absence: Flinto for Mac is a desktop app sold as per-copy yearly licence keys ($99, volume $89/$79); Flinto Lite (web) is $20 per member per month, with 10% off yearly (annual figure not listed, so the monthly price is recorded). Neither mentions SSO, SCIM, directory sync or an API. Okta's catalogue 'Flinto' app is SWA (password vaulting) only.
